# The Reliant merge queue's infra patterns for control-plane's gate
# (.reliant/pipeline.yaml, gate.infra_patterns_file). One Go RE2 regular
# expression per line, matched against a failing gate stage's log: a match
# makes the failure infra (unproven: retried on another gate machine, never
# landed and never blamed on a PR), not red. Blank lines and # lines are
# skipped.
#
# Only what says nothing about the code under test belongs here: the classes
# the gate itself reports as "not PR blame" (docs/local-gate.md, rule 9) and
# the host failures scripts/rc/mains.sh's INFRA_RE already classifies. A
# pattern a real test failure could print would let a red change land unproven
# forever, so each is the exact text the failing tool prints.

# The docker daemon is down or wedged (internal/testsrv, scripts/lib/gate-containers.sh).
Cannot connect to the Docker daemon
dockerd unresponsive

# The gate's own health verdict, never a PR's (scripts/ci-gate.sh health_failure, exit 3).
GATE HEALTH FAILURE

# A heavy slot never came (scripts/heavy-lock.sh, HEAVY_LOCK_TIMEOUT).
heavy-lock: \S+ gave up waiting after [0-9]+s

# The disk, memory and file-descriptor budgets.
no space left on device
ENOSPC
cannot allocate memory
too many open files

# A registry's rate limit or outage (internal/testdocker's registryRateLimited).
toomanyrequests
429 Too Many Requests
You have reached your pull rate limit
received unexpected HTTP status: 5[0-9][0-9]
